017package org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp.auth;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020
021/**
022 * Bridges a Dynamic-Client-Registration result ({@link McpClientRegistration}) into F1's existing token flows &mdash;
023 * the {@link McpAuthorizationCodeAcquirer} (interactive auth-code + PKCE) and {@link McpTokenProvider}
024 * (client-credentials / refresh).
025 *
026 * <p>
027 * DCR changes only how the {@code client_id}/secret were obtained; it does <b>not</b> alter the {@code resource=}
028 * (RFC 8707) or {@code iss} (RFC 9207 / SEP-2468) enforcement those flows already perform &mdash; the caller still sets
029 * {@code resource(...)} / {@code expectedIssuer(...)} exactly as for a statically-configured client.  These helpers only
030 * transplant the DCR-issued credential material (and, for the acquirer, keep the loopback redirect <em>path and port</em>
031 * consistent with what was registered, so a bind-first {@link LoopbackRedirectUris#forPort forPort} registration matches
032 * at a strict exact-match authorization server).
033 *
034 * @since 10.0.0
035 */
036public final class McpClientRegistrations {
037
038   private McpClientRegistrations() {}
039
040   /**
041    * Applies a DCR-issued registration's {@code client_id}, optional {@code client_secret}, and registered loopback
042    * redirect path (and port, for a bind-first registration) onto an {@link McpAuthorizationCodeAcquirer.Builder}.
043    *
044    * <p>
045    * When the registration's first redirect URI carries an explicit port (a bind-first
046    * {@link LoopbackRedirectUris#forPort forPort} registration), that port is wired onto the builder via
047    * {@link McpAuthorizationCodeAcquirer.Builder#redirectPort(int) redirectPort} so the loopback receiver binds exactly
048    * the port the authorization server was told; a port-agnostic registration leaves the acquirer on its ephemeral-port
049    * default.
050    *
051    * @param builder The acquirer builder.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
052    * @param registration The DCR-issued registration.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
053    * @return The same builder, for chaining.
054    */
055   public static McpAuthorizationCodeAcquirer.Builder configure(McpAuthorizationCodeAcquirer.Builder builder, McpClientRegistration registration) {
056      assertArgNotNull("builder", builder);
057      assertArgNotNull("registration", registration);
058      builder.clientId(registration.clientId());
059      registration.clientSecret().ifPresent(builder::clientSecret);
060      // Keep the loopback receiver's callback path AND port consistent with the redirect URI that was actually
061      // registered: a strict exact-match AS matches the redirect URI exactly, so a bind-first forPort(port,path)
062      // registration only works if the receiver binds the same path and the same port.
063      if (! registration.redirectUris().isEmpty()) {
064         var redirect = registration.redirectUris().get(0);
065         var path = redirect.getPath();
066         if (path != null && path.startsWith("/"))  // HTT: java.net.URI#getPath() returns "" (not null) for a hierarchical URI with authority and no path -- the null case is only reachable for an opaque URI, which a DCR redirect URI never is
067            builder.redirectPath(path);
068         var port = redirect.getPort();
069         if (port > 0)
070            builder.redirectPort(port);
071      }
072      return builder;
073   }
074
075   /**
076    * Applies a DCR-issued registration's {@code client_id} and optional {@code client_secret} onto an
077    * {@link McpTokenProvider.Builder} (client-credentials / refresh modes).
078    *
079    * @param builder The token-provider builder.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
080    * @param registration The DCR-issued registration.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
081    * @return The same builder, for chaining.
082    */
083   public static McpTokenProvider.Builder configure(McpTokenProvider.Builder builder, McpClientRegistration registration) {
084      assertArgNotNull("builder", builder);
085      assertArgNotNull("registration", registration);
086      builder.clientId(registration.clientId());
087      registration.clientSecret().ifPresent(builder::clientSecret);
088      return builder;
089   }
090}
